words.gloss: if they attempt to go further

literal: Those who climbed the tip of a branch, if they attempt to go beyond that, it will end up becoming the end of their life.
translation: If those who have climbed to the very tip of a tree branch attempt to push further beyond that limit, it will result in the end of their life.
modern: மரக்கிளையின் நுனிவரை ஏறியவர்கள், அந்த எல்லையையும் தாண்டி மேலே செல்ல முயன்றால், அது அவர்களுடைய உயிருக்கே முடிவாகிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a vivid physical metaphor to warn against overreaching one's limits. A climber who has already reached the absolute tip of a branch is at the peak of danger; if they try to push even further, the branch will break, leading to a fatal fall. In the context of acting according to one's strength, it teaches that exceeding the absolute limit of one's capacity, even after achieving great heights, brings total ruin. The word 'ookkin' here refers to the foolish attempt to exert oneself beyond the safe boundary, which inevitably ends in disaster.
